releases.body:
First release, published on npm as [`opencode-account-quota`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-account-quota).

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-account-quota
```

- `/quota` modal with the remaining quota of each connected account.
- DeepSeek balance per currency with a low-balance notice.
- ChatGPT (Codex) and Claude Code 5 h / weekly usage, experimental and off by default (`experimentalCodexUsage`, `experimentalClaudeUsage`).
- Route order of accounts with a preview of the next turn.

Tested with OpenCode 2.3.2, 2.4.1 and 2.4.2.
